description: This file contains JavaScript code for admin interface functionalities, including AJAX loading, table row reordering, typeahead search, modal content loading, and editable fields, with license information at the top.

methods.name: getSearchParams
methods.description: Parses URL search parameters and returns value for a given key or all parameters.

methods.name: adminProntoLoad
methods.description: Loads content via AJAX into a target element, defaulting to '#admin-content'.

methods.name: adminOrderColumn
methods.description: Enables drag-and-drop reordering of table rows with AJAX update and pagination support.
